recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Future edits to MoneyQuantity should preserve the corrected `code.exists()` invariant, but no current FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-15611.
issue_request: FHIR-15611 asked to correct the STU3 Money mny-1 invariant to `(code.exists() or value.empty()) and (system.empty() or system = 'urn:iso:std:iso:4217')`.
initial_application: Git history shows SVN revision 13439 as commit 19d34d51c846e16ada19d52db5f08a79802ce96e, which changed source/datatypes/money.xml from `(code or value.empty())` to the requested `code.exists()` expression.
additional_context: FHIR-16297 later reworked Money by introducing a specific Money datatype with value/currency and renaming the old Quantity-based profile to MoneyQuantity. Current fhir.ini keeps Money and MoneyQuantity in active datatype scope; current Money has value/currency rows, while MoneyQuantity retains the corrected Quantity-style invariant.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the old code/system invariant to current Money would be incorrect because those elements no longer exist on Money; the corrected invariant is preserved where the Quantity-style profile still applies.

related_jiras.note: Published follow-up that reworked Money into value/currency and renamed the old Quantity-based profile to MoneyQuantity, determining how the FHIR-15611 invariant should be interpreted now.
